prioritized_defects.description: The video search selection is modeled as mutually exclusive branches from a single 'Search type selected?' decision, so the diagram does not clearly support the required independent selection of video host searching and video link searching in the same search. Requirements R10 and R11 each define separate tick boxes, and R32 depends on both R28 and R30. The current branching structure suggests only one of the video modes can be taken at a time instead of allowing either or both to be included.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R28 and R30 require separate tick boxes for hosting and link sites, and R32 states the search sends queries to the video websites based on the search term after both selection steps. In the diagram, N9 branches into [torrent], [video hosting], and [video link], but there is no structure showing the video hosting and video link queries can both be executed for one search when both boxes are ticked.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Replace the mutually exclusive video branches with conditional paths that can both be taken when both tick boxes are selected, or use separate guarded actions under a shared search-start flow so hosting and link queries can run independently.

prioritized_defects.description: The outline's analysis lists parallel activities (Torrent search and video stream search can be configured independently before a search is started.) but no step is a fork.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Draw the parallel activities as a fork step, or remove the entry from parallel_activities if they happen in sequence.

prioritized_defects.description: On the torrent no-results path, the diagram immediately stops after displaying the message. The requirement only asks for the message to be displayed; it does not require an explicit early termination of the whole activity from that point. This termination is not supported by the requirements and may prevent the user from continuing with other flows in the combined diagram.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R5 only states that if no results are found, the system displays 'No results were found for this search.' The diagram adds N15 stop immediately after N14 on the torrent branch.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Remove the explicit stop from the torrent no-results branch unless the model is intended to terminate the entire activity there for a documented reason; let the branch end naturally or rejoin the common flow.

prioritized_defects.description: Step 'display no results message' is drawn 2 times (N14, N26).
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Draw a step shared by several branches once, before the decision or after the branches rejoin.

final_recommendation: Fix the high-severity control-flow and concurrency defects first, then address the medium-severity termination and duplicated no-results step in the same repair batch if capacity allows.
